# Calculate mean and median mpg for each of the top 3 displacement values
results = []

for disp in top_3_displacements:
    # Filter data for this displacement value
    mpg_values = df[df['displacement'] == disp]['mpg']
    
    # Calculate mean and median
    mean_mpg = mpg_values.mean()
    median_mpg = mpg_values.median()
    
    # Round to 2 decimal places
    mean_mpg_rounded = round(mean_mpg, 2)
    median_mpg_rounded = round(median_mpg, 2)
    
    results.append((disp, mean_mpg_rounded, median_mpg_rounded))
    
    print(f"Displacement: {disp}")
    print(f"  Count: {len(mpg_values)}")
    print(f"  Mean MPG: {mean_mpg_rounded}")
    print(f"  Median MPG: {median_mpg_rounded}")
    print()

print("Summary of results:")
for i, (disp, mean_val, median_val) in enumerate(results, 1):
    print(f"Displacement {i} ({disp}): mean={mean_val}, median={median_val}")
